title: random

messages.description: set the range and output a random value

methods.description: set a seed value for repeatable random numbers

body:
Random outputs pseudo random integers from 0 to N-1 where N is the creation argument. You can specify a seed if you wish. Seeds are kept locally so that if two Randoms are seeded the same they will have the same output (or indeed you can seed the same one twice to repeat the output.)

On the other hand, if you don't supply a seed, each instance of random gets its own seed. Nothing is known about the quality of the pseudo random number generator: it isn't any standard one.
